messages:
rachel: Quick triage — customer asks: full Console flow for model pinning vs an API-only contract for programmatic pinning. need a decision for next sprint planning.

jose: who asked and what's the need? many customers just want the API for infra automation.

rachel: Customer A (enterprise) says admin UI is required for biz sign-off. Customer B (platform) wants API-first to automate releases. both are high ARR.

vikram: my quick take: prioritize API surface for programmatic pinning first, then Console admin later. reduces dev friction for integrators.

amanda: disagree slightly — Console helps sales close enterprise deals faster. launch criteria: must be able to show legal/compliance teams a UI for audit traces.

dave: can we quantify? propose RICE attempt for two options.

ellie: +1 to quantifying. also think about sequencing to unblock both customers. maybe an API + thin Console proxy.

jose: here's a tiny RICE calc (very rough):
```
Option A (API-first): Reach=60, Impact=7, Confidence=0.7, Effort=5 -> Score=(60*7*0.7)/5=58.8
Option B (Console-first): Reach=30, Impact=6, Confidence=0.6, Effort=3 -> Score=(30*6*0.6)/3=36
```

jose: conclusion from those numbers: API-first looks higher ROI.

amanda: caveat: RICE misses sales friction. If Console unlocks two enterprise deals this quarter it's high impact. we should fold commercial multiplier.

vikram: ok fair. proposal: ship API v1 (core endpoints + audit logs) in sprint 1, and a minimal Console wrapper in sprint 2 (read-only admin UI that shows pinned models + audit). that meets compliance demo needs.

rachel: that sequencing seems pragmatic. launch criteria for sprint 1: API endpoints + tests + docs + example terraform. acceptance: a customer integration can pin/unpin and fetch audit entries.

ellie: sprint 2 Console MVP acceptance: authentication, list view, basic audit timeline, and an "apply pin" button that calls the API. no fancy UX.

product-bot: note created: "Pinning: API-first + Console-MVP sequencing" owners: @vikram (eng), @amanda (sales), @rachel (pm). due: 2 sprints.

dave: risks: doubling work if Console requires separate perms or a different backend model. mitigations: design API with admin scopes from day one.

jose: operational note: instrument latency/usage per endpoint so Redwood Optimize can suggest batching for pin churn.

rachel: final: agree to API-first + shallow Console in follow-up. action items: vikram to spec API surfaces by EOD Wed, amanda to line up compliance contact, rachel to add to roadmap and PRD.

amanda: :thumbsup: will prepare enterprise talking points.

ellie: leaving a small UX caveat — console list may need search early if customer audit is big, flagging for sprint 2 backlog.

rachel: thanks all. I'll post PRD link when done.
